svg.text: MRC sprays packets from one RDMA connection across multiple ECMP paths and places them directly into memory at the receiver.
To the endpoints: one RDMA connection
The sender changes the hash input
Packets can arrive out of order
The receiver places each packet directly
into the right memory location. No reordering.
Packet 4 was dropped in the network.
Only the missing packet is resent.
A late packet that still shows up is just placed, not resent.
